name: Janix
description: Janix was a planet located in the Mid Rim Territories. The planet's capital city and main feature was Janix city, a neon-lit and shadow-soaked city with towering skyscrapers built into a crater. The world was self-governed under a functioning democracy with a fragile balance between its Tactical Defense Force and the gangsters and crime syndicates, who kept peaceful under a tacit accord for their own business interests. Following the formation of the Galactic Empire, the former Sith Lord Maul and leader of the Shadow Collective attempted to rebuild his criminal syndicate on Janix at the same time as the Empire and the Inquisitorius also arrived, leading to conflict between the two groups, the local criminal underworld and the local police force. Maul also met the former Jedi Padawan Devon Izara on the planet.
